subject: Cannot open the data stored in my Shinyapp-->www folder

messages.author: 408c1f1fb3767480
messages.subject: Cannot open the data stored in my Shinyapp-->www folder
parts:
Hi, 

This is my first time deploy my ShinyApp in shinyapp.io so I encountered couple problems I am trying to figure out. 

One issue I have now is that: I created a www folder in my local MyshinyApp folder, then put my data: data.csv file in it. After deployApp() I am trying to read the data.csv using the url link: https://ningningchen.shinyapps.io/MyshinyApp/data.csv . However, i couldn't get this to work. It gives me the error: cannot open the connection.

I did notice that this link is https:// not http://. So in my server.R, instead of reading it directly as: read.csv("url"), I guess I will have to do something to let R be able to read my the data.csv from this security link? I tried RCurl package and getURL(url) but still no luck. Anyone has any good suggestion?

Thanks,
Ningning

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Cannot open the data stored in my Shinyapp-->www folder
parts:
Ningning,
I think you want to have your data.csv at the top level, or if you wanted, you could have a data directory and use: read.csv("data/data.csv")  
The www is for serving of static assets, and in this case you aren't serving that asset.
HTH
-Tareef
